The structure of Mg(CuO2)2 crystallizes in triclinic symmetry with space group P1 (No. 1) and contains a 9-atom unit cell with 9 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu centers in both octahedral and four-coordinate O environments, with Cu–O distances ranging from about 1.88 to 2.63 Å. Mg centers coordinate to four O neighbors. The octahedral Cu polyhedra display corner- and edge-sharing, while Cu–Mg polyhedra show corner- and face-sharing. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 9 sites.
